tagline: Operational support for professionals who have outgrown doing everything alone.
description: Virtual administration and executive support with Alexia Annmari — inbox, calendar, systems, and day-to-day operations for busy professionals and business owners.
hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM

insuranceNotes: Packages are billed monthly. Pricing shown is placeholder and can be adjusted before launch.
Engagements begin with a short intro conversation to confirm fit, priorities, and communication rhythm.
A limited number of client seats are available at a time to keep support consistent and attentive.

packages.name: Essential Support
packages.summary: Day-to-day virtual admin for professionals who need consistent help with the essentials — inbox, calendar, and staying organized — without deeper operations work.
includes: Weekly business briefings so you stay clear on priorities without chasing updates
Inbox support and non-sensitive client or stakeholder communication
Calendar management — coordination, reschedules, and reminders
Digital organization — files, documents, and notes hygiene
communication: Weekly strategy and execution call (30 minutes)

packages.name: Signature Package
packages.summary: For professionals who need support inside the business — not only around it. Structure, follow-through, and client-facing operations handled with ownership.
includes: Client experience support across onboarding, active work, and wrap-up
Meeting support — agendas, materials, notes, and follow-ups
Proposal and contract coordination — send, track, and nudge
Progress and milestone tracking so nothing stalls midstream
communication: Weekly strategy and execution call (30 minutes)

packages.name: Executive Tier
packages.summary: Highest-touch partnership: day-to-day admin, operations, and oversight so larger moving pieces stay aligned while you focus on the work only you can do.
includes: Billing support — invoicing, payment tracking, and follow-up
CRM hygiene — contacts, notes, follow-ups, and pipeline upkeep
Visibility support — scanning opportunities and preparing materials
Launch support for new offerings and operational backends
Content repurposing from notes and existing material into shareable drafts
communication: Weekly strategy and execution call (up to 45 minutes)
